summary: Grey scale pastels cast darkness over our moonlit canvas An emotional swirl in hundred of colors leaving me tired, streaks of stuttering monochrome film trapped in a technocolor world #smallpoems
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Grey scale
pastels cast
darkness over
our moonlit
canvas
An emotional
swirl in hundred
of colors leaving
me tired,
streaks of stuttering
monochrome
film trapped
in a technocolor
world
#smallpoems
